descriptionMarkdown:
#### Overview
- Small, easy to start, and generates all basic Fulgora unique items
- 60 SPM
- Balanced: Will continue work forever as long as scarps are coming it
- Several versions depends on your tech level and island size
- Includes Rails Production (Except for the minimal version)


#### To start:
- Connect to power
- Add 50 logistics bots
- Connect inputs

#### Changing modules:
- Use the best quality modules you've got instead those of in the blueprint
- Use the best efficiency modules you've got instead those of in the blueprint
- Beacons can use faster speed modules, but for balance it is best to keep all beacons in the same speed modules tier
- Don't change the speed modules on the recyclers - it will change nothing, but will use more power

#### 12/6/2025 - Version 0.7
- Added beacons production
- Added speed, efficiency and productivity level 2 modules production
- Added logistics network chests production
- Added circuits logic to priorities EMPs over other products
- Bug fixes

#### 31/5/2025 - Version 0.6

- Rebuilt half of the factory to double SPM
- Red belts version added
- Fixed a bug with speed beacon reaching quality structures
title: Fulgora Starter Factory
